claims.text: For black exhaust smoke, the indicated diagnostic system is the engine diagnostic system.
The engine diagnostic system identifies issues such as fuel system problems or excessive fuel injection.
During air-intake PMCS checks, correct CDR-valve function is determined by ensuring the CDR valve opens and closes smoothly and properly during the intake cycle, allowing proper airflow.
The authorized CDR-valve cleaning method is wiping the valve surface with a clean, dry cloth.
No solvents or abrasive materials are permitted for cleaning the CDR valve.
